description: Flat prediction log for Oracle track. Used by Was I Right? retrospectives and quarterly calibration scoring. Mirrors predictions in concepts.json but optimized for scoring calculations.

predictions.claim: China will not achieve commercial-scale 7nm chip production (>50,000 wafers/month) by Q4 2027.
The US-China semiconductor dispute will produce partial bifurcation rather than full decoupling or renewed convergence by 2028.
The US will not achieve 20% of world advanced-node semiconductor production domestically by 2030.
At least one G7 country will formally weaken semiconductor export controls or secure major carve-outs (>$1B annual revenues) by Q4 2027.
China's semiconductor self-sufficiency will remain below 50% of domestic demand by 2028.
The United States and China will not produce a joint AI safety communiqué with shared technical vocabulary for model evaluations or compute thresholds by December 31, 2026.
predictions.note: Script frames this as 30% probability of a joint communiqué emerging. Inverted here to the 'will not occur' form for Brier-scoring consistency with the rest of the log (which scores 'event will not happen' claims). 70% = 1 - 30%. Watch signals: NPT RevCon vocabulary (reciprocal restraint vs shared standards), AISI joint publications, bilateral AI communiqué language. Disconfirmer: a major actor publicly reframes the conflict as a coordination problem and outcomes shift in the predicted direction. Episode falsification clause: if a reframing occurs and outcomes don't shift, the 'wrong game' thesis weakens.

calibrationSummary.note: baselineBrier is Brier score of always predicting 0.5. A calibrated forecaster should beat this over many predictions.
